question: How is enjoyment in the ocean of existence artistically expressed through the goddess?
premises: She is Gāndhārī of enjoyment in the ocean of existence.
She is strung or woven with enjoyment in the ocean of existence.
inference: The goddess embodies enjoyment in worldly existence through musical and interwoven artistic forms.
uncertainties: gāndhārī may refer to the musical note/mode Gāndhāra or to the figure Gāndhārī.
plain_english: She is the Gāndhārī of enjoyment in the ocean of existence and is strung together with enjoyment in the ocean of existence.
